appearance_scorer.note: Selected among several variants (score blends, top-K, merging, prominence) by dev leave-one-clip-out; the held-out clip was scored for every variant, so it is no longer fully untouched for this comparison. See README, 'Appearance scorer'.

hand_annotated.note: Edited footage: an editor's cut often lands exactly on a step change, and a detector of sudden picture change gets those boundaries for free. recall_1s splits each scorer's recall into boundaries at a cut and boundaries not at a cut; the latter is the part that needs the hands.

heldout_set.note: Every held-out clip, scored at each scorer's frozen global configuration chosen on the development clips.
